source: DHM Quran Recitation (QRA1) · lesson 9. From Dr. Hassan's course; every word in his voice, every verse by Sheikh Al-Minshawi.
topic: Read shaddah and recite Surat Al-Kawthar

learn.en: Shaddah looks like a small seen on top of the letter. It means the letter is doubled: the first one has sukoon and the second has a short vowel. To say it, split the letter into two.
learn.title: Shaddah

learn.en: Now we read the name of the surah.
learn.title: The surah

learn.en: Listen to Sheikh Al-Minshawi recite Surat Al-Kawthar. Follow with your finger, then recite it yourself.
learn.title: Surat Al-Kawthar
learn.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ ﴿١﴾ فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ ﴿٢﴾ إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ ﴿٣﴾

learn.en: At the end of any gathering, the Prophet ﷺ advised us to say this du'aa: Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise. We bear witness that none has the right to be worshiped except You. We seek Your forgiveness and we turn to You in repentance.
learn.title: At the end of our lesson
learn.ar: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، نَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، نَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَنَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
learn.tr: Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, nashhadu an la ilaha illa anta, nastaghfiruka wa natubu ilayk

quiz.en: True or false? Shaddah means the letter is doubled.

think.q: Can you find shaddah in the surah of this lesson?
think.a: Follow the words with your finger while Sheikh Al-Minshawi recites, then read them yourself.

parents.summary: Shaddah: Read shaddah and recite Surat Al-Kawthar.
parents.tip: Ask your child to read the words to you slowly, then recite the verses together.
